decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a flagship building block of the firm's track system, and other system components depend on it, so its option value is high and its carrying cost is low.
This LED line sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep listed, but newer LED families from 2019 give the firm alternative options, which leaves a moderate risk of pruning.
The home automation server box supports the firm's automation direction, and uncertainty about its value has not resolved, so keeping this option justifies its modest cost.
This luminaire family is close to the established range and was given its own page, but after four years, and with newer families available, it faces some risk of being replaced.
